evidence: Remote hosts (ssh/sandbox) never ran a job. defaultHostTransport.run sends {id, files, outputs} with no command, and swarm-remote-exec (tools/remote-exec.mjs) waits forever when the request has no command and returns files: []. Found on 2026-10-14 by feeding the transport's real payload to remote-exec; it only ever passed with stub transports (tests/executors-run.test.mjs). dev2 later proved reachable over real ssh.
rule: A feature that talks to another machine is not done until a test runs it against a real host; stub transports prove only the scheduling around it.
fix: In the next phase PR: send the agent command and args in the request, run it remotely in the shipped workspace, return the declared outputs with sha256, and add a test against a real ssh host (dev2) that skips when no host is configured.
public: Remote hosts were only tested with stub transports and sent no command to the remote side; a real-host test is now required.

evidence: On 2026-10-15 swarm update 1.62.0 to 1.65.0 did not create ~/.local/bin/swarm or the completion file. updateInstall runs inside the old process, whose already-loaded install.mjs ran, so install steps added by the new release never ran on the update that introduced them. Running node tools/install.mjs --user afterwards fixed it.
rule: An updater must run the installer of the version it installs, in a fresh process, not the code already loaded.
fix: In the next phase PR: after checking out the new tag, run node <root>/tools/install.mjs --user in a child process and report its result; add a test that update from an older fixture install creates the swarm command.
public: swarm update ran the previous release's installer; it now runs the new release's installer in a fresh process.

evidence: 2026-10-28 run 1793217685082-c71f3db9: codex gpt-6.1-sol job returned blocked, saying it could not read its declared outputs because the preamble says 'Read only the files in your context; other reads may be denied.'
rule: Worker preambles must say outputs are readable as well as context: 'Read only your context files and your declared outputs.'
fix: Change the codex (and any similar) preamble line to name declared outputs as readable; add a test that the message names both.

evidence: 2026-10-28 mini Opus seat: 'swarm ask --context a --context b' silently kept only the last value, so 7 PR reviews (#430,#434,#435,#437,#438,#440,#443) saw only the changed file, not the diff.
rule: A repeated single-value CLI flag must refuse (or accumulate for list flags like --context), never silently keep the last value.
fix: In ask/scout/sweep flag parsing, make --context accumulate across repeats (or refuse a repeat with a clear error); add a test that two --context flags give both files.
